title: OpenMind command
description: Intent decoded from EEG, published on openmind/v1/commands. Objects must ignore it unless they received a status in the last 2 s and confidence reaches their own threshold.

command.description: left/right hand, forward (feet), rest, action (double jaw clench: a muscle signal, not a brain signal).

confidence.description: Probability of the command, after evidence accumulation.

ts.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC) when the message was created.

seq.description: Message counter of the publisher, +1 per command message; lets objects detect losses and reordering.
